commerce.notePlaceholder: Note: visible in history when changing status…
commerce.invoiceLinkRequirement: Order must be confirmed and paid to link an invoice.
commerce.howItWorksOrder: An order is a purchase commitment (after quote or directly from the storefront). It carries a payment (card/CIB, transfer, PayPal, check, COD), delivery (zone/fees), invoice (ERP or upload) and status tracking: pending → pending_payment → paid → processing → shipped → delivered (or cancelled). Multi-select allows bulk status change or deletion with history.
commerce.howItWorksQuote: A quote is a priced estimate before purchase. Cycle: draft → submitted → processing → replied → accepted/rejected (or revision/expired). accepted can auto-convert to order (Admin → Quotes setting), the original moves to transformed with link to order. Validity (days) auto-expires to expired. Bulk allows accepting/converting multiple quotes at once.

commerce.linesTitle: Lines — fees & discounts per item (before confirmation)
commerce.linesHint: Per line: discounts (fixed or %), predefined VAT, shipping fees (fixed/per qty/free) and zones. Admin can add a fee per item or globally before confirmation — total recalculates with global config (per zone/qty).
commerce.globalShippingFee: Global shipping fee (DZD) — 0 = auto per zone
commerce.feesHint: Tip: leave empty for auto per zone (Shop → Global configuration). You can also add a fee per item above — both add up.
commerce.manualValue: Manual value applied — save to update storefront & PDF instantly.
commerce.calculation: Calc: subtotal → product discounts → global → coupon → taxes (product VAT priority + global) → shipping (items + zone).

faq.q: What types of ultrasound do you offer?
faq.a: We offer portable and fixed ultrasound machines with various probe configurations. All devices are CE certified and ISO 13485 compliant.

faq.q: Are blood pressure monitors medically certified?
faq.a: Yes, all our monitors are Class IIa medical devices, CE certified with ESH protocol validation.

faq.q: Do you provide training on how to use the equipment?
faq.a: Yes, a basic training session is included with every purchase. Advanced training is available as an option.

cardiology.desc: ECG, defibrillators, cardiac monitors and holters

faq.a: Yes, we offer 3, 6 and 12-lead ECGs with touch screen and built-in thermal printer.
Yes, all our AEDs feature step-by-step voice guidance and automatic rhythm analysis in under 10 seconds.

imagerie.title: Medical Imaging
imagerie.desc: CT scanners, MRI, digital radiology and PACS solutions

faq.a: Yes, from entry-level 16-slice to high-end 128-slice, with installation and training included.

faq.q: Are the MRI scanners suitable for all patients?
faq.a: Yes, our MRI scanners suit every patient profile, including children and people with claustrophobia (open MRI available).

chirurgie.title: Surgery
chirurgie.desc: Surgical instruments, autoclaves, LED surgical lights

faq.a: Yes, all compliant with EN 13060 standards with vacuum drying cycle.
Yes, all our surgical lights are LED with a 50,000-hour lifespan, a CRI above 95 and intensity up to 150,000 lux.

faq.q: Are incubators suitable for premature babies?
faq.a: Yes, from 28 weeks of gestation with precise temperature, humidity and oxygen control.
Our paediatric scales are accurate to 5 g, with a hold function for restless babies and a tare function for nappies.
Yes, we offer semi-automatic and fully automatic AEDs with voice guidance.

faq.q: Do the emergency trolleys come fully equipped?
faq.a: Yes, our trolleys ship with everything required: defibrillator, monitor, suction unit, oxygen and emergency drugs.

faq.q: Are your EMR solutions HDS compliant?

questions.q: Where to find the code and key?
questions.a: On all official SARI Système SARL documents: invoices, quotes, certificates, product labels. The code follows the format SARI-XXX##-#####.

questions.q: What does the code format mean?
questions.a: SARI (company prefix) + Type code (FAC, DVV, etc.) + Year + Sequence number. Ex: SARI-FAC24-00001 = Invoice 2024 #00001.

questions.q: What to do if the document is not recognized?
questions.a: Contact our support immediately. It could be a forgery or an entry error.
'Revoked' means the document was cancelled by us (e.g., cancelled order). 'Invalid' means the document was reported as forged or altered.

questions.q: How long do documents remain valid?
questions.a: Invoices and quotes are valid indefinitely. Certificates have a variable validity period (1 to 5 years depending on the type).

legal.title: Legal Notice and Authenticity
legal.intro: The SARI Système SARL authenticity verification system guarantees the origin and validity of all official documents and products issued by our company. Each document contains a unique code in the format
legal.andKey: and an encrypted verification key allowing instant authentication.
legal.legalValueDesc: Documents verified as authentic by this system have full legal and commercial value under current Algerian legislation. In case of dispute, the positive verification result is proof of the document's authenticity before competent jurisdictions.
legal.antiCounterfeitDesc: SARI Système SARL is actively committed to fighting the counterfeiting of documents and medical products. Any document not recognized or reported as forged by our verification system must be considered suspicious and reported to our services as well as to the competent authorities.
legal.dataProtectionDesc: Verification information is processed confidentially and is not stored beyond the verification session. In accordance with
legal.lawDesc: relating to the protection of natural persons in the processing of personal data, no personal data is retained during the verification process.
legal.warningDesc: Forgery of official documents is an offense punishable by criminal prosecution under the Algerian Penal Code (Articles 214, 217 and 147). If in doubt about the authenticity of a document, contact our services immediately or the competent judicial authorities.
